entities.name: Ciboney and Arawak Settlement
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The earliest inhabitants, the Ciboney, settled Saint Vincent around 5000 BCE, followed by Arawak peoples who migrated from South America's Orinoco region. They established agricultural and fishing communities across the main island and several Grenadine islands.
